derivation: Generated by tools/import_kicad_board.py from the vendor's own KiCad footprint. Pad centres are exact to three decimal places in millimetres, scaled at 8.0 px/mm from a 20.91 x 24.55 mm extent including a 1.0 mm margin. Pin names joined from the symbol library on pad number. Nothing here was measured off an image.
assumption: Every `pin` is null: that field is the rcontrol pin index of a PICSimLab board implementation (webui/pinmap.py), and none exists for this board. `chip_pin` and `chip_index` are what tools/import_pindefs.py read out of the sources named in `pindefs`: the vendor's own CAD, `seeed-pcb`, for `MTDI`, `MTDO`, `MTMS`, `MTCK`, `BOOT`, and the board-support packages for the rest; a pad whose `chip_pin` is null says why in `why_null`. webui/boards/esp32c5.py reads a level through the same table, so a pad with a `chip_pin` answers for itself in the pin view; a pad without one is drawn and reported as not modelled.

pindefs.derivation: Generated by tools/import_pindefs.py from the sources in `packages`, at those revisions, and not every one of them is a board-support package. The vendor's own CAD among them, `seeed-pcb`, answered `MTDI`, `MTDO`, `MTMS`, `MTCK`, `BOOT`; the board-support packages, `arduino-esp32`, `zephyr`, answered every other pad that resolves. Nothing was inferred from the silkscreen or a pinout image: a label resolves only when every source in `packages` that defines it names the same pin, and `python tools/import_pindefs.py <board>` prints the file that named it.
